basic_details.organization_name: Post Graduate Institute of Medical Education and Research (PGIMER)

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for PGIMER Scientist-B (Medical) Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: www.pgimer.edu.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 10-09-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for PGIMER Scientist-B (Medical) Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.pgimer.edu.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 10-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the PGIMER Scientist-B (Medical) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the PGIMER Scientist-B (Medical) post is 10th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Scientist-B (Medical) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree from an NMC recognized college and an MD in Microbiology or Community Medicine from a recognized institution. Additional relevant research experience and computer knowledge are also required.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Scientist-B (Medical) position is 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per the rules and regulations of the Government of India.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Scientist-B (Medical) post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 67,000 per month, plus HRA (House Rent Allowance) as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for this job?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. You need to download the application form, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it to the official address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Scientist-B (Medical) role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Test followed by an Interview. Candidates need to perform well in both stages to be considered for the position.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type and contract period?
faq.answer: The job is on a contractual basis. The contract period is expected to end on 31st March 2027, as indicated in the important dates.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of PGIMER, www.pgimer.edu.in. Links are also provided in the "Important Links" section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is VIRO/VRDL/2026/349. It is important to mention this number in your application if required.
